verdict_text: YES. The script drops every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14 by regex match on the block index, renumbers survivors in original order to 0..11, passes the 4 non-block tensors through unchanged, and writes a single `out/T1/model.safetensors`. The assertions run before the save, so a violation exits non-zero with nothing written; the index-set check guarantees no block 12..15 remains and exactly 12 blocks are present, and the length check enforces 184 tensors.
